text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you shouldn't have. Thank you for
the
birthday wishes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hweh?! W-we were just about to wish
you happy
birthday, but now you've
already thanked us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Always stay one step ahead! That's the
Bakushin
birthday way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What?! Already racing into next
year—that's the
Bourbon speed I know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But speed happens to be my forte as
well! Thank
you for next next year's
birthday wishes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Then happy next next next birthday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've done it again, Bourbon! Well
then, thank
you for next next next next
year's birthday wishes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: How did this turn into a competition...
